curation.notes: Vertical magnetic tweezers measuring force-dependent lifetimes of single-chain-linked α-actinin spectrin-repeat (SR) rod dimers (ACTN1, ACTN4 homo/hetero-dimers, truncated SR dimers, Entamoeba histolytica SR1-SR2) in shear and unzip geometries; constructs tethered via SpyTag003/SpyCatcher to the surface and AviTag-biotin to M270 beads, optionally with a 572-bp DNA handle. Bell-model fits give k0 and transition distance.
